# TrueFoundry Docs

> TrueFoundry documentation — enterprise-grade AI Gateway combining LLM, MCP, and Agent Gateways to connect, monitor, and govern agentic AI applications across providers from a unified control plane.

## Docs

- [Access Data From S3 Or Other Clouds](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/access-data-from-s3-or-other-clouds-jobs.md): Learn how to access data from S3 and other cloud storage in batch jobs on TrueFoundry.
- [Access Cloud Services Like S3](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/access-data-from-s3-or-other-clouds-services.md): Guide to accessing S3 and cloud data sources from services deployed on TrueFoundry.

- [Adding Environment Variable](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/adding-environment-variable.md): How to add and manage environment variables for jobs and services on TrueFoundry.
- [Adding Retries And Handling Failures](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/adding-retries-and-handling-failures.md): Learn how to configure retries and handle failures in production workflows.
- [Overview](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/agent-registry.md): The single place to build, register, discover, and govern every AI agent in your organization — whether built on TrueFoundry or running anywhere else.
- [Remote Agents](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/ai-gateway/agents/remote-agents.md): Register agents running on any platform — Bedrock, Vertex AI, LangGraph, or custom infrastructure — into a unified control plane with governance.

A secret version for each of the created secret is created with version number as 1. The returned secret group does not have any secret values in the <em>associatedSecrets</em> field. A separate API call to `/v1/secrets/{id}` should be made to fetch the ass…
- [Delete Secret Group](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secret-groups/delete-secret-group.md): Deletes the secret group, its associated secrets and secret versions of those secrets.
- [Get Secret Group](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secret-groups/get-secret-group.md): Get Secret Group by id. This method does not return the secret values of the <em>associatedSecrets</em> in the response. A separate API call to `/v1/secrets/{id}` should be made to fetch the associated secret value.
- [List Secret Groups](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secret-groups/list-secret-groups.md): List the secret groups associated with a user along with the associated secrets for each group. Filtered with the options passed in the query fields. Note: This method does not return the secret values of the <em>associatedSecrets</em> in the response. A separate API call to `/v1/secrets/{id}` shoul…
- [Update Secret Group](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secret-groups/update-secret-group.md): Updates the secrets in a secret group with new values. A new secret version is created for every secret that has a modified value and any omitted secrets are deleted. The returned updated secret group does not have any secret values in the <em>associatedSecrets</em> field. A separate API call to `/v…
- [Delete Secret](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secrets/delete-secret.md): Deletes a secret and its versions along with its values.
- [Get Secret](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secrets/get-secret.md): Get Secret associated with provided id. The secret value is not returned if the control plane has `DISABLE_SECRET_VALUE_VIEW` set
- [List Associated Active Deployments](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secrets/list-associated-active-deployments.md): List the active deployments that are associated with a secret.
- [List Associated Active Deployments for Multiple Secrets](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secrets/list-associated-active-deployments-for-multiple-secrets.md): Returns the union of active deployments associated with any of the given secret IDs. Only secrets the user has read access to are considered.
- [List Secrets](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): List secrets associated with a user filtered with optional parameters passed in the body.
- [Create or Update a Team](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/teams/create-or-update-a-team.md): Creates a new team or updates an existing team. It ensures that the team name is unique, valid, and that the team has at least one member. The members of the team are added or updated based on the provided emails.
- [Delete Team](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/teams/delete-team.md): Deletes the Team associated with the provided Id.
- [Get Team](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/teams/get-team.md): Get Team associated with provided team id
- [Get Team Permissions](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/teams/get-team-permissions.md): Get all role bindings associated with a team.
- [List Teams for User](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/teams/list-teams-for-user.md): Retrieve all teams associated with the authenticated user. If the user is a tenant admin, returns all teams for the tenant. Pagination is available based on query parameters
- [Get filtered spans data with detailed attributes](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/traces/get-filtered-spans-data-with-detailed-attributes.md)
- [Activate User](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/activate-user.md): Activate user associated with the provided email within the tenant.
- [Change Password](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/change-password.md): Change password for the authenticated user. Requires clientId and loginId in the request body.
- [Check user registration](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/check-user-registration.md): Check if a user is registered with the platform
- [Deactivate User](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/deactivate-user.md): Deactivate user associated with the provided email within the tenant.
- [Delete User](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/delete-user.md): Delete user if they are not a collaborator in any resource and not part of any team other than everyone.
- [Get User](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/get-user.md): Get User associated with provided User id
- [Invite User](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/invite-user.md): Invite a user to the tenant
- [List Users](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/list-users.md): List all users of tenant filtered by query and showInvalidUsers. Pagination is available based on query parameters.
- [Register Users](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/register-users.md): This endpoint allows tenant administrators to register users within their tenant.
- [Resend Invite](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/resend-invite.md): Resend the invite to the user
- [Update User Profile Picture](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/update-user-profile-picture.md): Update the profile picture URL for the authenticated user
- [Update User Roles](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/users/update-user-roles.md): This endpoint allows tenant administrators to update the roles of a user within their tenant.
- [Check Virtual Account Exists](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/check-virtual-account-exists.md): Check whether a Virtual Account with the given name exists in the current tenant.
- [Create or Update a Virtual Account](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/create-or-update-a-virtual-account.md): Creates a new virtual account or updates an existing one based on the provided manifest.
- [Delete a JWT for a virtual account](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/delete-a-jwt-for-a-virtual-account.md): Delete a JWT for a virtual account by id
- [Delete a Virtual Account](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/delete-a-virtual-account.md): Delete a virtual account associated with the provided virtual account id.
- [Get token for a virtual account](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/get-token-for-a-virtual-account.md): Get token for a virtual account by id
- [Get virtual account](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/get-virtual-account.md): Get virtual account by id
- [List Virtual Accounts](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/list-virtual-accounts.md): List virtual accounts for the tenant.
- [Regenerate token for a virtual account](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/regenerate-token-for-a-virtual-account.md): Regenerate token for a virtual account by id. The old token will remain valid for the specified grace period.
- [Sync virtual account token to secret store](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/virtual-accounts/sync-virtual-account-token-to-secret-store.md): Syncs the virtual account token to the configured secret store. Returns the updated JWT with sync metadata including timestamp and error (if any).
- [Create or Update Workspace](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/workspaces/create-or-update-workspace.md): Creates a new workspace or updates an existing one based on the provided manifest.
- [Delete Workspace](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/workspaces/delete-workspace.md): Deletes the workspace with the given workspace ID.     - Removes the associated namespace from the cluster.     - Deletes the corresponding authorization entry.
- [Get Workspace](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/workspaces/get-workspace.md): Get workspace associated with provided workspace id
- [List Workspace](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/workspaces/list-workspace.md): List workspaces associated with the user. Optional filters include clusterId, fqn, and workspace name.
- [Search workspaces](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/api-reference/workspaces/search-workspaces.md): List workspaces the user can read with optional structured `filter` (name, id, environmentId, cluster_fqn) and pagination.

- [Deprecation of Common Tools in Playground and Settings — v0.135](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/deprecation-of-common-tools-v0-135-0.md): Built-in common tools are deprecated from Playground and Settings in v0.135.0 and fully removed after 15 May 2026.
- [Deprecation of MCP Servers in Prompts](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/deprecation-of-mcp-servers-in-prompts.md): MCP servers can no longer be attached to new prompts starting 28th April 2026. Existing prompts with MCP servers will continue to work until 30th May 2026.
- [Gemini CLI Model Registration Requirement — v0.118](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/gemini-cli-model-registration-v0.118.md): From v0.118.1, all Gemini CLI models must be registered in the TrueFoundry Gateway for cost calculation and attribution.
- [Guardrails YAML Schema Change — v0.116](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/guardrails-yaml-schema-change-v0.116.md): MCP Guardrails feature launched in v0.116 introduces breaking changes to the guardrails YAML schema for GitOps users.
- [Legacy MCP OAuth Routes Removal — v0.134](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/legacy-mcp-oauth-routes-removal.md): Legacy unscoped MCP OAuth routes are being removed in favor of scoped OAuth Protected Resource Metadata endpoints (RFC 9728).
- [MCP Gateway URL and Transport Changes — v0.130](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/mcp-gateway-url-transport-v0.130.md): v0.130 introduces smarter MCP Gateway URLs with OAuth chaining and a breaking change in transport protocol handling.
- [MCP Server Groups Removal — v0.112](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/mcp-server-groups-removal-v0.112.md): MCP Server Groups are removed from v0.112. MCP Servers are now standalone, top-level resources with simplified management.
- [AI Gateway Metrics Rename — v0.136](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/refactoring-of-ai-gateway-metrics.md): Metric names in AI Gateway are being renamed. A dual-write transition period lets you migrate dashboards and alerts without downtime.
- [x-tfy-routing-config Header Removal — v0.133](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/routing-config-header-removal-v0.133.md): The x-tfy-routing-config request header is retired from AI Gateway in v0.133. Migrate routing logic to Virtual Models.
- [Simplified GitOps CI/CD with tfy apply — v0.132](https://www.truefoundry.com/docs/change-announcements/simplified-gitops-cicd-v0.132.md): From v0.132, use a single tfy apply command to replace complex per-file CI/CD scripts for GitOps workflows.
